newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates steady at 3.0 to 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates steady at 3.0 to 4.0 pct.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates were unchanged on Wednesday at around 3.00 percent to 4.00 percent in a quiet market depressed by low demand, bankers said.
One banker reported rates as low as 2.5 percent.

Bankers have attributed the softer market this week to start-of-month salary transfers by ministries and public institutions to the banking system along with weaker subsription in last week's 15 million dinar certificate of deposit (CD) auction.
